title: Stereocontrolled four-carbon homologation of vicinally functionalized allylic pyrrolidines to highly customized azonines bearing remote benzylic stereocenters
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20810-20814
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03502C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Timothy K. Beng, Ailan Johnsen, Alan Gitonga, Jasleen Kaur
Vicinally functionalized (bis) allylic pyrrolidines have been skeletally remodelled via HFIP-promoted aza-Cope rearrangement to highly decorated nine-membered azaheterocycles (azonines), which harbor benzylic stereocenters.
